$schema.description: Path to the JSON schema file

roots.description: Source root directories to watch Elm files.

assets.description: Static assets directory to serve (e.g. public).

files.description: List of Elm module names containing components to preview.

stylesheets.description: List of CSS file paths to link in the preview page.

scripts.description: List of Javascript file paths to include in the preview page.

imports.description: List of Elm import statements to include globally in Shiori.Route.elm (e.g. Json.Decode as Decode).
